territories.name: Saint Lucia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Saint Lucia levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 15.42, administered by the Inland Revenue Department: section 9 imposes it on the taxable supply and the taxable import, section 10 at 12.5 per cent, with a rate of 7 per cent for tourism accommodation and 10 per cent for restaurant food and beverages, water sports, tours and attractions under S.I. 188 of 2020, a zero rate for the supplies of the First Schedule and exemption for those of the Second.
